import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtSeparated
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0Et
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

-- does the new instance make PicSchemeEt separatedness gate-free?
example {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] :
    IsSeparated (Scheme.PicSchemeEt C).hom := by
  infer_instance
